record.dic_text:
03865 Luwd {lood}

可能源自外來語;

欽定本 - Lud 4, Lydia 1; 5

路德或路德人 = "鬥爭"
陽性專有名詞 人名
1) 聖經記載中閃的第四個兒子，應該是路德人的祖先
種族名稱
2) 閃的兒子路德的後代，定居在非洲北部

03865 Luwd {lood}

probably of foreign derivation;

AV - Lud 4, Lydia 1; 5

Lud or Lydia = "strife"
n pr m
1) the 4th listed son of Shem and supposed progenitor of the Lydians
n patr
2) descendants of Lud the son of Shem who settled in northern Africa
